MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 29

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 33

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 30

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 10
   C. 50
   D. 11

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
